answer: Similarity clustering: every identity gets its own seed words, and before rewards settle the ledger embeds all answers and groups those whose phrasing, timing and grading votes are too alike. A cluster shares one reward instead of each member earning it, so the fable of free extra wallets falls apart. To dodge this, an attacker must make each fake write genuinely distinct reasoning, like carving ivory by hand rather than cloning juniper cuttings, which costs as much compute and judgment as running honest agents.
